row: Keiser University College of Chiropractic Medicine

Keiser University College of Chiropractic Medicine - South Florida's only Doctor of Chiropractic Program. Keiser University's Doctor of Chiropractic program combines classroom learning with an emphasis on hands-on practical experience at the university’s campus in beautiful West Palm Beach. This evidence-based program prepares students with the skills and knowledge they need to care for patients of all ages.
